title: Godot 4.6 locks up newest Linux Mint distribution after being used for 2+ hours.
body:
### Tested versions

Only version I've used is v4.6.1.stable (From the Linux App-image downloadable from the website).

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Linux Mint 22.3 (Zena) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (nvidia; 580.126.09) - AMD Ryzen 5 5500 (12 threads) - 31.23 GiB memory

### Issue description

This has happened to me twice now in the same day. I've been working on a game (written in GDScript), and after long periods of time of using Godot (possibly in combination with the Picture-In-Picture display I use for YouTube videos while I work), my computer freezes up (with the exception of the mouse cursor and audio) and no keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl + Alt + Del, Ctrl + Alt + F1/F2/F3/F4/F5/F6, etc.) work at all.

### Steps to reproduce

Turn on Linux Mint 22.3 machine
Have a video playing in Picture-In-Picture mode (I use Firefox and YouTube for this)
Open Godot 4.6
Be working on a project for 2+ hours
Whole PC freezes except for mouse cursor - no keyboard shortcuts do ANYTHING. (Audio from video still continues to play.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I have yet to produce this part (due to taking so long to reproduce the bug).
